tools.description:
Run a short read-only shell command for inspection. Input: {"cmd": str}
Usage: for listing files, checking git state, grepping sources. Commands run in the repository root with a short timeout; mutating commands are rejected.

tools.name: edit
tools.description:
Replace exactly one occurrence of old_str with new_str in a file. Input: {"path": str, "old_str": str, "new_str": str}
Usage: the match must be unique in the file or the call fails. Read the file first, pick a minimal unique snippet, and prefer the smallest possible replacement that fixes the bug.

tools.name: glob
tools.description:
List files matching a glob pattern. Input: {"pattern": str}
Usage: patterns use shell-style wildcards; results are sorted paths relative to the repository root. Use to discover test files and module layout before reading.

tools.name: read
tools.description:
Read a file from the repository. Input: {"path": str}
Usage: returns the file contents with line numbers. For long files read in slices; do not re-read a file you have already seen unless it changed on disk.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description:
Run the repository test suite, returns pass/fail lines. No input.
Usage: runs the full suite; output lines are FAILED/PASSED per test. Run after every edit; fix one module at a time and confirm with a re-run before moving on.

tools.name: bash
tools.description:
Run a short read-only shell command for inspection. Input: {"cmd": str}
Usage: for listing files, checking git state, grepping sources. Commands run in the repository root with a short timeout; mutating commands are rejected.

tools.name: edit
tools.description:
Replace exactly one occurrence of old_str with new_str in a file. Input: {"path": str, "old_str": str, "new_str": str}
Usage: the match must be unique in the file or the call fails. Read the file first, pick a minimal unique snippet, and prefer the smallest possible replacement that fixes the bug.

tools.name: read
tools.description:
Read a file from the repository. Input: {"path": str}
Usage: returns the file contents with line numbers. For long files read in slices; do not re-read a file you have already seen unless it changed on disk.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description:
Run the repository test suite, returns pass/fail lines. No input.
Usage: runs the full suite; output lines are FAILED/PASSED per test. Run after every edit; fix one module at a time and confirm with a re-run before moving on.

tools.name: edit
tools.description:

tools.name: glob
tools.description:
List files matching a glob pattern. Input: {"pattern": str}

tools.name: read
tools.description:

tools.name: run_tests

Run the repository test suite, returns pass/fail lines. No input.
